stoppingReason: planned program completed (see individual incomplete conditions)
limitations: Internal related-engine tournaments do not establish human strength or Elo.
Timed games vary with host scheduling; worker isolation cannot control unrelated host processes.
Only available historical boards/opening roots can be excluded; unpublished old trajectories are unavailable.
Physical macOS Intel and Apple Silicon acceptance is outstanding.
Behavior-policy outcomes are not minimax labels; TD estimates the mixed behavior policy.

protocol.selectionRule: highest mean pair points over predefined selection conditions; ties development relative MSE then ID
protocol.evidenceRule: 128 moderate and 64 longer confirmation pairs, simultaneous lower bounds > .5 at 80 and 300 ms; no automatic production change

freeze.rule: highest mean pair points over predefined selection conditions; ties development relative MSE then ID

publicationNotes: Weights, complete game trajectories, logs and checkpoints remain local.
Accepted game index/seed pairs allow regeneration with generateGame() at the original framework commit.
Pair outcomes permit independent recomputation of W/D/L, scores, margins and the predefined intervals.
Published roots/reference boards must be added to exclusions before any future fresh-confirmation study; v1 does not automatically read this new report.
Task-wall totals overlap during parallel work; they are not independent process CPU totals.
